claims.text: Therapist guided CBT-I reduced sleep onset latency in a randomized trial of 120 adults, with benefits persisting at six-month follow-up.
Adherence to CBT-I may decline among participants with shift work schedules, indicating the need for individualized monitoring and support.
The generalizability of CBT-I trial findings is limited because patients with comorbid depression were excluded.
Digital sleep interventions reproduce parts of therapist guided CBT-I but show variable effect sizes and limited durability evidence, making therapist guided CBT-I the stronger benchmark.
